A. through
B. while
C. beside
D. once

items.question: The Ambrose Music Company markets its products only -- its dedicated Web site.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“through”代入题干后为“The Ambrose Music Company markets its products only through its dedicated Web site.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：A（through）。
